statement: Axeyum executes the exact complete Chapter 15 A0, RV64I, and x86-64 XOR-reduction programs and checks typed entry, loop-head, after-combine, and terminal relations on eight declared finite word lists.
scope: Eight named 64-bit word lists of length zero through three; exact 44-byte A0, 36-byte RV64I, and 21-byte x86-64 Chapter 15 programs; data base 0x100, x86 return stack 0x400, continuation 0x800; concrete execution, complete memory frame, typed cut-point comparison, and architecture-specific terminal conventions.
exclusions: Lists longer than three in the evidence report

negative_control.mutates: Change only RV64I's pointer increment from eight to one and require the pointer clause to fail at the second loop head

limitations: The checker directly executes eight declared finite cases; the chapter's invariant and movement proofs carry the universal argument.
The report binds concrete semantic source and program digests but does not retain a solver certificate.
The core harness rejects more than 96 words to prevent data and return-stack overlap, while the evidence report intentionally uses at most three.
